call.label: 1. Call the two repeat loci
call.description: Run ExpansionHunter on two synthetic CAG controls: a fully spanned 12/18 genotype and a longer 12/75 expansion. The longer allele is estimated with a confidence interval.

sort.label: 2. Sort the generated BAMlet
sort.description: Sort ExpansionHunter's realigned reads by coordinate for REViewer. This consumes the BAMlet generated by the first preset.

index.label: 3. Index the sorted BAMlet
index.description: Build the BAI index that REViewer needs for indexed access to the sorted BAMlet.

review.label: 4. Draw the supporting read evidence
review.description: Run REViewer on the newly generated repeat calls and alignments. Select either SVG result to inspect read evidence; metrics and phasing tables are also retained.

count.label: 5. Count the realigned reads
count.description: Count alignments in the generated BAMlet and save standard output as a text file.

repeat-controls.label: Normal and expanded CAG controls
repeat-controls.description: Explicitly synthetic paired reads with known CAG alleles 12/18 and 12/75. The long allele exceeds read length, so its confidence interval is checked against the constructed truth. No human-derived reads.
